segs.vo: This is KINETIX Board, the AI smartboard in every Soundarya classroom. Everything you'll see is the real board app, driven by a stylus, just as a teacher uses it.

chapters.title: Sign in and start the class

segs.vo: Signing in takes one scan. The teacher opens the KINETIX Teacher app and scans this QR code, or types the six digit code. No passwords on a shared screen.
If the internet is down, the board shows a signed offline code instead, and the phone verifies it without any network.
Teachers can also keep a personal PIN for this board. Set it once, and from then on the board unlocks on a shuffled keypad, so nobody learns it from smudges on the glass.
The board already knows the class from the timetable: Class 10 B, Science, Refraction through a glass slab. And it suggests concept videos for this period, in English, Hindi and Kannada.
Today's plan brings the lesson plan from the ERP: objectives, timed steps, materials and homework, with a step timer to keep pace.
Books shows the NCERT syllabus, and which topics have been taught. The profile menu keeps your saved whiteboards. Your lesson recordings. Teacher training. And a guided tour.

chapters.title: Ink that feels like a pen

segs.vo: Now the canvas. The pen panel sets the pen type. The thickness. And the colour. With pressure, smoothing and palm rejection for a real stylus.
Handwriting flows naturally. The ink keeps up at full writing speed, with no lag, and it's smoothed just enough to stay crisp on a big panel.
The shapes tool draws a clean glass slab. A line marks the normal, and arrows trace the incident ray, the refracted ray, and the emergent ray leaving the slab.
Labels go on by hand: air, glass, the angle of incidence and the angle of refraction. The highlighter sits behind the ink, so nothing gets covered.
The eraser removes whole strokes. Undo and redo step back and forth through every change.
Select with a lasso, then move it anywhere. The selection bar can resize, duplicate, group or lock it.
Real geometry tools live in the drawer: a ruler, a protractor, a compass and set squares. Here the protractor goes on the board, to move, rotate and measure against.
The AI pen turns handwriting into clean, typed text, right where it was written. And with Shape AI switched on, a rough sketch snaps into a perfect circle.
Equations are typeset properly. Here is Snell's law, placed straight onto the board.
The math solver works offline, and shows every step of the working.

The tools drawer holds the rest, filtered by subject. For science: a periodic table, circuits and atoms. For maths: graphs, equations and statistics. And for computer science: flowcharts, code labs and logic gates.
Add pages as the lesson grows. Here, page two gets Snell's law, written by hand. The page overview shows every page at a glance, to jump between them, reorder or export.
Backgrounds and templates: ruled, grid, dots, or a chalkboard, for one page or for all of them.
Every board is saved for the class, and can be shared with students on WhatsApp, by email, or with a QR code.
The side panel brings content in without leaving the board. 3D models render right here: rotate them with the stylus, and read off their measurements as you teach.
Virtual labs make the lesson hands-on. In the glass slab lab, change the angle and the ray bends in real time.
There are PhET simulations that work offline. Animations. Concept videos. And the subject kit, with the periodic table, formulas and constants.
From the Add menu, bring in PDFs and PowerPoint slides, pictures, tables, sticky notes, word cards and covered answers. The side panel adds a safe browser for the web, and a document camera.

chapters.title: KINETIX AI, built into the lesson

segs.vo: KINETIX AI answers questions about the lesson, in the class's language, with sources, and follows the syllabus.
The AI lesson builder drafts a full plan for a topic: objectives, steps, activities and an exit ticket, ready to teach.
It also writes quick quizzes. Homework. And lecture notes. It summarises the board, and Read board reads whatever has been written on it.
Attendance is taken on the board in seconds and synced to the ERP.
Ask the class: pose a multiple choice question, and students answer from the Student app or by holding up printed answer cards that the camera scans.
Answers build live on the board as students respond. End the question to reveal the right answer, and see at a glance who needs help.
Or ask for a word cloud. Students type a word or two from their phones, and the cloud grows as they answer, with the most common words largest.

And there's a full classroom toolkit. A random picker chooses who answers next. A timer keeps activities on track. Scoreboards run team quizzes. Badges reward good work. The group maker splits the class in one tap. And multi-user zones let several students write on the board at once.
Homework AI turns the lesson into an assignment and sends it to the Student app, with a due date.
Submissions are reviewed by classmates on a rubric, and AI suggests marks that the teacher approves, in the Teacher app.
For accreditation, each question is tagged with course outcomes, so every poll and quiz becomes OBE evidence in the ERP.
Record the lesson with one tap. The board shows a consent notice, then records with chapter markers. Hold a marker to star an important moment.
Recordings come back with a transcript, a summary and chapters, and can be shared with enrolled students.

Live captions help every student follow along. In the Cast panel, phones share their screen after the teacher approves. Screen projection mirrors the board to a second display. And Freeze screen holds the picture while the teacher sets up the next step.
Eye comfort warms and dims the panel for long teaching days. Break reminders follow the twenty twenty twenty rule. And the whole board switches to a dark theme in a single tap.
The whole board speaks English, Hindi and Kannada, and switches instantly. Each teacher's language follows them when they sign in.

There are tools for every learner. Voice commands control the board hands free. The immersive reader reads the page aloud. A screen shade reveals the board step by step. A spotlight focuses attention. And a magnifier enlarges any detail.

Board settings hold the language, theme and writing options, with a simple mode of big labelled tools. The toolbar can be customised. Touch lock keeps the panel safe in kiosk mode. And device diagnostics report its health to the IT console.
When the network drops, the board keeps working. Changes wait in an outbox and sync as soon as it's back.
End the class, and attendance, polls, homework, recordings and lesson evidence flow to the KINETIX ERP. And on to the Teacher app, the Student app, and the Parent app.
KINETIX Board. Every lesson, connected.
